description: P. Muhandiramge Premalatha v. P.H. Geeganage Ariyathillake P. Muhandiramge Premalatha v. P.H. Geeganage Ariyathillake View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: P. Muhandiramge Premalatha v. P.H. Geeganage Ariyathillake P. Muhandiramge Premalatha v. P.H. Geeganage Ariyathillake View More
keywords: Plaintiff sought ejectment of tenant following termination of tenancy agreement. Key issue was whether the premises fell under the Rent Act. Held - Plaintiff failed to prove by sufficient evidence that the premises were situated outside the Rent Act\'s controlled area since a mere assertion is insufficient proof; thus, the trial judge erred in finding against the defendant on this unproven issue. Appeal allowed.
